description: This file defines a TypeScript module related to setting up a WhatsApp integration within a plugin framework. It exports a setup wizard object that manages configuration status, resolution logic, and finalization procedures for WhatsApp accounts.

methods.name: resolveConfigured
methods.description: Determines if any linked WhatsApp account exists for the given configuration and account ID.

methods.name: resolveStatusLines
methods.description: Generates status messages indicating whether WhatsApp accounts are linked, considering default account and actual linked status.

methods.name: resolveShouldPromptAccountIds
methods.description: Decides if the setup should prompt for account IDs based on the provided options.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Completes the WhatsApp setup process using provided configuration and context.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the WhatsApp setup channel in the configuration.

methods.name: onAccountRecorded
methods.description: Callback invoked when an account ID is recorded, possibly triggering further actions.
